Newtyn Management Increased Holding in Time Warner (TWX) by $5.19 Million; Eidelman Virant Capital Boosted Its Holding in Apple (AAPL) as Market Valuation Declined
April 26, 2018 - By Kurt Siggers
Noah Levy increased its stake in Time Warner Inc (TWX) by 21.27% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Newtyn Management Llc bought 57,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.97% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Noah Levy held 325,000 shares of the television services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $29.73 million, up from 268,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Newtyn Management Llc who had been investing in Time Warner Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $75.08 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.25% or $0.24 during the last trading session, reaching $96.28. About 4.08 million shares traded. Time Warner Inc. (NYSE:TWX) has declined 3.25% since April 26, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 14.80% the S&P500.
Eidelman Virant Capital increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 12.87% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Eidelman Virant Capital bought 2,100 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 18,415 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.12M, up from 16,315 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Eidelman Virant Capital who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $830.36B market cap company. The stock increased 0.44% or $0.71 during the last trading session, reaching $163.65. About 28.38M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
